resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union's security team approve or reject analyst Dev Patel's software-exception request within their published five-business-day service window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the security team communicated an approval or rejection decision to Dev Patel before the end of the five-business-day window (i.e., by 2026-08-14T17:00:00-08:00, assuming business days are Monday-Friday and excluding weekends). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-08-17T17:00:00-08:00.
